description: This file defines classes related to F1 Application Protocol (F1AP) DU Bearer implementations for UE context management, including handling of SDUs, PDUs, and notifications for specific bearer types in a 5G network.

classes.name: f1c_srb0_du_bearer
classes.description: Handles the DU bearer for SRB0, managing SDU handling, PDCP notifications, and PDU processing.

classes.name: f1c_other_srb_du_bearer
classes.description: Manages other SRB DU bearers, including PDU handling, notifications, and RRC delivery reports.

classes.name: event_context
classes.description: Represents the context for protocol transaction events, including PDCP SN, event source, and observer.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles the SDU (Service Data Unit) for transmission, packaging it into RRC messages.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Processes transmit notifications for PDCP SNs.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Processes delivery notifications for PDCP SNs.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes incoming PDUs, with optional RRC delivery status request.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_delivery
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for delivery confirmation within a specified timeout.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_transmission
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for transmission confirmation within a specified timeout.

methods.name: handle_rrc_delivery_report
methods.description: Handles RRC delivery reports as per 3GPP TS 38.473 specifications.
